links.outcome: Acceptability and continuation intent under transparent vs covert therapist AI use
links.effect: Covert AI use produced the strongest declines in acceptability and continuation intent; transparency reduced but did not eliminate negative reactions (all p<0.001 vs control).
links.quote: Transparency reduced, but did not eliminate, negative reactions.

links.effect: Therapist AI use reduced acceptability and continuation intent versus control; all p<0.001; covert use produced strongest declines.
links.quote: Across all models, therapist use of AI substantially reduced perceived acceptability and continuation intent compared with the control scenario (all p<0.001).
